finalText:
Build's clean now — exit 0, "0 errors."

The bump changed how the bundler hands options to modules, and it broke two call sites that hadn't been updated:

1. **`src/core/options.js`** — options now arrive as `{ retryCount }` instead of `{ retries }`, so `options.retries` was `undefined` and `.toFixed()` threw. Fixed to read `options.retryCount`.
2. **`src/net/retryPolicy.js`** — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, but the strict boolean check only handled `true`/`false` and threw on anything else. Added an `undefined` → `false` (disabled) case, matching the old default behavior.

The remaining ~950 lines of deprecation/dedupe/progress noise are unrelated (real `DEP0xxx` Node deprecation warnings from the updated packages) and the build now reports "8 warnings, 0 errors" — those are just noise, not blockers.
